fixes.why: Everest being submerged by 2 km is not caused by the average depth (Everest is 8.849 m, so it would tower over an average depth of 3.682 m); it serves as a contrast, and average depth is an estimate rather than exact.
Sunlight penetrates down to approximately 1.000 meters (the dysphotic/twilight zone); 200 meters is only the boundary for photosynthesis (euphotic zone).
1.086 is the pressure in bar, which corresponds to roughly 1.072 times standard atmospheric surface pressure (1 atm ≈ 1,013 bar), not an exact 1.086 times.
